headline: Both saves show it: PINBALL's rescue lands with a chase
lede: Whichever kickback catches your falling ball, the table now says so — a lamp-chase climbs the save's own column and the solenoid gets its own grapple voice. On the way in, the never-dry audit retired two stale README claims.

notes.text: PINBALL #3766: gs.kbSweep rides both saves on both cabinets (one device-selected column law replacing the left-only sweep); 10 new pinballcheck pins, 6 named mutants all dying, plus a live Chrome pixel leg. Adventure's gate-rite gap proved stale (the guide tab shipped the manual in #1572) and Rogue's lamp/oil gap is unsourced for the 1980 original — both dispositioned with evidence.
Red main cleared while the PR waited: the nightly roster-regex fix (#3772) merged; nightly lanes cancel each other's dispatches, so the newest run gets watched, not re-fired.
Slot b shipped Missile Command hot-seat P2 battery buttons — the arcade three-button law finally reaches seat two (Z/X/C).

look.text: Missile Command — two players, three batteries each
